answer: Because the nadir solution is checked at the plume gate and logged, the reef audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch thus pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 24 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. Bonded capital sits idle for 18 days. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
